title: Dangerous function call_user_func (php) — review required
description: The php call call_user_func evaluates code, invokes by name, or uses a removed database extension. Untrusted input becomes execution or failure. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer removes it via direct calls or an allowlist.
remediation: Remove or use direct calls or an allowlist.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any call_user_func call matches.
